project_type: Flutter Web (student app + admin dashboard) + NestJS REST API + PostgreSQL (Supabase)
build_system: Flutter: standard flutter build web; NestJS: npm run build. No monorepo tooling.
test_framework: Flutter: flutter analyze (no widget test suite in place). NestJS: npm run lint (eslint). No jest tests present.
build_command: web_app: flutter analyze; admin_dashboard: flutter analyze; backend: npm run lint
test_command: flutter analyze (both Flutter projects); npm run lint (backend)
verification_instructions: 1. cd backend && npm run lint (must exit 0). 2. cd web_app && flutter analyze (must show no issues). 3. cd admin_dashboard && flutter analyze (must show no issues).
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Backend deployed to Render (campuscore-bfrq.onrender.com). Supabase Storage bucket is named 'Resources'. app.module.ts uses entities glob so new entity files are auto-discovered — no manual entity registration needed there; only the module import in AppModule is required.
contribution_requirements: AppColors / AdminColors only (no hardcoded hex). Nunito font. ConsumerWidget/ConsumerStatefulWidget. Riverpod. Use ref.read (not ref.watch) inside FutureProviders. All new Flutter files must analyze clean.
key_patterns: NestJS modules follow: backend/src/modules/<name>/ with entities/, dto/, <name>.entity.ts, <name>.service.ts, <name>.controller.ts, <name>.module.ts. Use @Public() for public routes; @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard) for protected; @CurrentUser() for user injection. TypeORM repositories, ConfigService for env vars. Flutter: GoRouter routes in app_router.dart / admin_router.dart. Sidebar nav items in app_shell.dart (_navItems list) / admin_shell.dart (_navItems const list). API constants in web_app/lib/core/constants/api_constants.dart. AdminApi via singleton adminApi from admin_dashboard/lib/core/utils/api_client.dart. SupabaseStorageService.uploadFile() from web_app/lib/core/storage/supabase_storage.dart.
directory_structure: CampusCoreNew/backend/src/modules/<module>/ — NestJS feature modules. CampusCoreNew/web_app/lib/ — Flutter student web app (screens, providers, router, shell, constants). CampusCoreNew/admin_dashboard/lib/ — Flutter admin web app (same structure). CampusCoreNew/database/schema.sql — PostgreSQL DDL. CampusCoreNew/.agents/tasks/ — plan artifacts.
